title: gpu-operator: exec-command-go @ cmd/nvidia-validator/main.go:669

root_cause.note: Validator runCommand helper executes fixed in-tree commands inside privileged validator pods.

preconditions: validator pod compromised or validator spec command injection
steps: resolve the pinned tag/commit and file:line
verify the claimed snippet and source SHA256
record a static-only verdict (no exploit execution)
expected_evidence: static-check.json with source hash and line match
notes: NVIDIA GPU Operator validator pods run privileged with hostPath mounts (see 0500_daemonset posture case) and execute shell/nvidia-smi via runCommand. Callers are fixed in-tree (shell/nvidiaSMIPath), so the exec sink is not tenant-reachable by itself; the finding is the privileged execution surface of validator/driver DaemonSets, which pairs with the elevated-pod-spec hits in manifests/state-driver/0500_daemonset.yaml.
